fn TotalBurningHours(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  requires (b >= 2)
  ensures (result == (if (a == 0) then 0 else if (a < b) then a else (a + TotalBurningHours((a / b), b))))
  ensures (result >= a)
  effects pure
  example (TotalBurningHours(0, 2) == 0)
  example (TotalBurningHours(1, 2) == 1)
{
  if (a == 0) then 0 else if (a < b) then a else (a + TotalBurningHours((a / b), b))
}

fn solve(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 1)
  requires (a <= 1000)
  requires (b >= 2)
  requires (b <= 1000)
  ensures (result >= a)
  ensures (result == TotalBurningHours(a, b))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
